name: Naphtuh
overview: Naphtuh is a male figure identified in Scripture as a son of Mizraim. Beyond this paternal relationship, the biblical record does not provide additional details about his tribe or other attributes. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical in nature.
namesAndTitles: The name Naphtuh appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:13. No specific meaning or divine origin of the name is recorded, so it is presented simply as a personal name within the biblical genealogy.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Naphtuh as a son of Mizraim, linking him to the descendants of Noah through Ham. No further familial relationships or tribal affiliations are documented beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Naphtuh's significance lies in his place within the genealogical framework of Genesis, which traces the nations descending from Noah's sons. As a son of Mizraim, he is part of the lineage associated with the peoples of Egypt. This genealogical mention underscores the biblical emphasis on God's sovereign ordering of nations and peoples.
